_about: Stage 3 rules (Eddie, 7 Nov 2026: 'create the rules for all of these'). Each rule: id, set, name, text (plain words), origin, added, in_sample (race keys the rule was seen on or written from; every other race is a test race). tools/eddie_rules.py runs every rule listed here on every race; tools/eddie_backtest.py scores them against docs/eddie_read/results/results.json. A new rule: add an entry here and its function in tools/eddie_rules.py (RULES dict), then commit before the next race.

rules.name: Pallas reached twice
rules.text: On one chart, two or more of sky Jupiter, sky Sun, sky Moon and that chart's own Jupiter reach that chart's natal Pallas (counting cells: whole, golden, conj from 50; ninth, φ power, √2, silver at any score), or a sky centre is conj natal Pallas.
rules.origin: rules register (claude/isolation-log.md), 5 Nov 2026, from the 44 races Apr 2021 - 5 Jan 2022; computed by tools/race_rows.py

rules.name: Chiron to Jupiter, lit by Sun / Moon
rules.text: Sky Chiron reaches the runner's H or J Jupiter, and the sky Sun or Moon reaches natal Chiron (either chart) or sky Chiron (a sky line, any score).
rules.origin: rules register, 5 Nov 2026 (An Tailliur, Exeter 19 Oct 2021)

rules.name: Moon to X, sky X to Jupiter
rules.text: The sky Moon reaches natal body X on one chart, and sky X reaches that chart's Jupiter.

rules.name: Line star on own Jupiter and on one body both charts
rules.text: A natal star on a sky Jupiter, Sun or Moon star line (any score) reaches that chart's own Jupiter, and the same star reaches the same body X on both charts (X not Jupiter).
rules.origin: rules register (Haydock 8 Jun 2020, The First Flow)

rules.name: Royal line star on own Jupiter
rules.text: A natal royal star (Regulus, Aldebaran, Antares, Fomalhaut) on a sky Jupiter, Sun or Moon star line reaches its chart's own Jupiter.

rules.name: Node axis
rules.text: A sky centre (Jupiter, Sun or Moon) is conj a natal node (Rahu or Ketu, conj >= 50, either plane), and the other node of that chart is reached by a Jupiter (sky, H or J) or by a natal star of that chart on a sky Jupiter, Sun or Moon star line.
rules.origin: rules register (Haydock 18 Dec 2021, Ffos Las 5 Jan 2022)

rules.name: Moon on a same body
rules.text: A loose same-body cell sky X -> natal X (either plane), and the sky Moon reaches the same natal X scoring 90 or more, same chart. X not Ketu.

rules.name: Sun / Moon on one body both charts, sky X to Jupiter
rules.text: The sky Moon or Sun reaches the same natal body X on both charts, and sky X reaches the runner's H or J Jupiter.

rules.name: Natal body on a strong line star (filter)
rules.text: Every runner holding the stage 1 flag 'natal body on a strong line star': a natal star of a sky Jupiter / Sun / Moon line scoring 90 or more, in conj (>= 50) with a natal body of the same chart. A field filter: it keeps holders, it does not pick one.
rules.origin: stage 1 flag; as a field filter after Aintree 13:50, 7 Nov 2026

rules.name: Top natal body on a strong line star
rules.text: The runner(s) with the highest score in the flag 'natal body on a strong line star' (candidate check 11; version 4 step 2).
rules.origin: candidate check 11, after Newcastle 11 Mar 2022 (read 6 Nov 2026)

rules.name: Version 4
rules.text: Step 1: the flag 'hub landing' held by exactly one runner -> that runner. Otherwise step 2: rule B2. No pick when neither fires.

rules.name: Same body, clear lead
rules.text: The runner with the most same-body cells (sky X -> natal X, either chart, either plane) scoring 50 or more, held alone with a lead of 2 or more over the next runner.
rules.origin: Eddie, 7 Nov 2026 (All In You, Aintree 13:50: 'when I look at same body for the winner it really stands out')

rules.name: Same body in both planes
rules.text: One natal body X with same-body cells sky X -> natal X scoring 50 or more in both RA and Dec on the same chart.
rules.origin: All In You, Aintree 13:50 (J Sun RA 57 and Dec 14×φ)

rules.name: Same body on both charts
rules.text: One body X with a same-body cell sky X -> H X scoring 50 or more and a same-body cell sky X -> J X scoring 50 or more (any planes).
rules.origin: All In You, Aintree 13:50 (Makemake H RA 10×φ^-1, J Dec 13)

rules.name: Most sky bodies onto the jockey's Jupiter
rules.text: The runner(s) with the most sky bodies reaching the jockey's natal Jupiter (stage 1 top rows 'S X -> J Jupiter', X a sky body other than Jupiter, either plane) scoring 80 or more; S Jupiter -> J Jupiter is the same-body cell and is not counted; ties: every runner on the top count; no pick when nobody has one. Jockey chart only, so it comes with the jockey to every ride.
rules.origin: Eddie, 7 Nov 2026 ('build 5'): filter 5 from the stage 2 data of Aintree 12:40 6 Nov 2026 (Risky Obsession / Harry Skelton: S Rahu 98.35, S Gonggong 93.71, S Sun 89.08, S Chiron 87.33). Its result on the other 19 races was looked at once before the rule was fixed (6 of 22 picks won, 3.7 by chance).
